title: service-messaging: redeliver on a parked dead row says the signing secret could not be resolved, even when the row was parked for another reason (a retired GET webhook method)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUZKdq3PK2Sab53cT3

Filed by area S6 from PR #34239 (#34098), dev report 6905346098. Category: misleading user-visible text.

**What happens.** `POST /api/v1/webhooks/redeliver` (`MessagingService.redeliverHttp`) on a parked `dead` row answers `DELIVERY_NEVER_SENT` with the text from `assertHttpRedeliverable` (`packages/services/service-messaging/src/http-outbox.ts`). That text says the row has no signature "because the signing secret it needed could not be resolved". Since #34098, a stored `sys_webhook` row with the retired method GET is parked through the same #8069 `recordUndeliverable` path, so its dead rows also answer this text. For those rows the clause is false; the reason recorded on the row (which the same text quotes) names the method.

**Ask.** Word the never-sent refusal so it does not name a cause the row does not carry: lead with the row's own recorded reason, and keep the signing-secret sentence only for rows parked for that reason (or drop it). Pin both shapes: a secret-park row and a GET-park row.

**Reach.** Operators redelivering a parked webhook delivery; about three lines in service-messaging. Not a behaviour change: the refusal code and status stay.

Dedupe words: redeliver DELIVERY_NEVER_SENT parked row signing secret wording; assertHttpRedeliverable parked reason text.
